carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes consistent with commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral region beneath the pectoral fin.
